introduction: Offer the dryad’s blossom, gather Majelle’s three ingredients, choose a wolf-pelt payment for Jamael, and understand Wolfspeed’s current mismatched recipe. Follow the keyed cave route toward Future Ceothia while keeping exact proof, earlier history, source recovery and travel distinct.
orientation: Arrive from Present Ceothia’s fixed time portal in the manor storeroom. Lenbrea’s badge reward supplies the Present bluestone key for that pickproof door. The Past arrival holds the black pack leader; woods, farms, Majelle’s shack and the bluestone rise form separate routes. There is no ordinary local boundary exit or local return portal to Present.

Ask the dryad, Majelle, Jamael and Wolfspeed their listed topics. The eight response families have twenty-one aliases, which reveal native responses rather than separate achievements. Use the actual majelle command alias even though her dialogue says Marjelle.

The exact secret white bell blossom has a floor source in the thinner forest; SEARCH can reveal it. Give it to the dryad for hair and a wooden potion tube; she departs. Her initial carried hair is another source, and supplied hair needs no personal blossom exchange.

Majelle asks for one exact hair, shard and blood red feather together. The demonic beast carries the shard and the blood hawk the feather. Several copies of one kind cannot replace the other kinds. Her key and vial are rewards; a narrated prophecy or plea never to return does not establish a restored timeline or retire her.

For the onward route, SEARCH the secret DOWN slab on the bluestone rise, then UNLOCK it with Majelle’s bluestone key and OPEN it. The outer cave leads WEST to the goblin shaman; his bone key opens the pickproof WEST boulder. The dragon inside carries the obsidian key for the secret DOWN trapdoor to the vault. All three keys break on successful ordinary unlocking; shared open routes or supplied keys do not prove your personal earlier quests.

The vault’s fixed unlimited ENTER portal leads to Future Ceothia. The vault also holds ordinary treasure, a ring and the staff of illumination, whose actual type is WAND. The working portal remains fixed and non-takeable. Future Ceothia has its own return portal through the time vortex; this journal does not record traversal or complete that foreign zone.

Jamael accepts one black, white or brown pelt for 500,000 copper. The corresponding female pack leaders carry them; their followers do not. The three recipes form one journal outcome with individual receipts retained. Do not require all colors or treat ordinary wolf combat as permanent farm protection.

Wolfspeed’s dialogue asks for a winter-wolf skull, but his current native recipe accepts the black pelt. The real winter wolf carries a distinct skull. The journal explains this mismatch without silently repairing it. A black pelt consumed by Jamael cannot also feed Wolfspeed; a supplied later copy still needs no personal kill.

Wolfspeed and the winter wolf start in rare wandering staging rooms with a dead-end dispersal sink and one one-way outlet into the forest. Room prose’s roughly six-percent claim is not a qualified spawn probability. Neither staging room is an ordinary player entrance, and source/reset evidence does not guarantee either actor’s live location.

The hair, feather, pelts, wooden tube and bluestone vial are distinct exact kinds. Two similarly named bracelet prototypes also differ. Drinking a potion, using the wand, wearing ordinary loot, killing the dragon or narrating a lightning ritual has no additional local accepted quest endpoint.

Current loose materials, historical accepted outcomes, first source recovery, gifts, access, combat, travel and effects remain separate. An old receipt never recreates a spent key or material. This area does not automatically reset. Fresh materials and recipient renewal are unqualified here; its three potential daily outcomes cannot yet be treated as reliably renewable.

Discovery has its own achievement, and meeting each terminal giver reveals its card. Active, ready accounting is mandatory for all new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit; frozen recovery is separate. No native recipe, spawn, key, portal or PvP mobility repair is enabled by this map.

contacts.name: a beautiful dryad
contacts.description: Starts in the thinning forest, carrying green hair. Accepts the white blossom for hair and a wooden potion tube, then departs. Her carried hair is an alternative source for Majelle.

contacts.name: Majelle
contacts.description: Starts in the run-down shack’s workshop. Native command alias is majelle; dialogue spells her name Marjelle. Needs all three exact ingredients together; gives the bluestone key and vial. Her plea never to return does not make her leave after the exchange.

contacts.name: Jamael
contacts.description: Starts in the grassy farm field with a sheep. Accepts any one exact black, white or brown pelt for 500,000 copper. His walking-away response does not retire the giver.

contacts.name: Wolfspeed the barbarian hunter
contacts.description: Starts in a rare wandering staging room. Current recipe accepts a black wolf pelt for the maw, while his dialogue asks for the actual winter-wolf skull. Exact behavior and repair proposal stay distinct; live presence is not guaranteed.

contacts.name: a red-eyed beast
contacts.description: Starts in the dense forest, carrying the exact bluestone shard and wearing a tiara. Prose about controlled firbolgs has no identified liberation endpoint; the shard is not a floor-mining reward.

contacts.name: a blood hawk
contacts.description: Starts at the beginning of the bluestone rise, carrying the exact blood red feather. Its flight/combat behavior and personal recovery are separate from supplied ingredient acceptance.

contacts.name: a powerful black female wolf
contacts.description: The black pack leader starts at the Past arrival, carrying the black pelt with three male and four young followers. Only this leader starts carrying that proof. Jamael and Wolfspeed compete for it.

contacts.name: a powerful white female wolf
contacts.description: The white pack leader starts at the bluestone rise, carrying the white pelt with three male and four young followers. It is a Jamael alternative, not the winter wolf or Wolfspeed’s current input.

contacts.name: a powerful brown female wolf
contacts.description: The brown pack leader starts in the dense forest, carrying the brown pelt with three male and four young followers. It supplies another Jamael alternative.

contacts.name: a winter wolf
contacts.description: Starts in the same rare wandering staging room as Wolfspeed, carrying the actual winter-wolf skull. Its authored staging/dispersal routes can remove it from ordinary access. The skull currently fails Wolfspeed’s black-pelt recipe.

contacts.name: a goblin shaman
contacts.description: Starts before the large cavern, carrying the small bone key and wearing a blackened bracer, with two goblin and one magi follower. The key opens the inner WEST boulder and breaks on ordinary unlocking.

contacts.name: the dragon of past and future
contacts.description: Starts inside the bluestone cavern, carrying the tiny obsidian key and wearing Dragon Past platemail. The key opens the secret DOWN vault trapdoor and breaks on ordinary unlocking; ordinary loot is not another quest receipt.

contacts.name: Lord Lenbrea
contacts.description: Present Ceothia’s Lenbrea accepts the Ceothian badge for the Present bluestone key to the time-portal storeroom. That exchange belongs to Present Ceothia. Its fixed portal arrives here; personal badge history is not a prerequisite of local supplied proofs.

stories.title: Dryad: offer the white bell blossom
stories.summary: Offer the exact white bell blossom for a lock of green hair and tiny wooden tube. The dryad departs after acceptance. The hair also starts carried by the dryad, so Majelle does not require your personal earlier blossom exchange. The tube is a potion; drinking it is a separate effect.
